name: Swami Chinmayananda
dates_notes: Born 8 May 1916 and died 3 August 1993; dates supplied by Chinmaya Mission biographical and publication records.

dates_evidence.description: Chinmaya Mission biographical and publication records.

core_thesis: Swami Chinmayananda was a twentieth-century Advaita Vedānta teacher and author whose published commentaries made the Bhagavad-Gītā, principal Upaniṣads, and Advaita teaching texts available to a broad modern readership. His work is expository rather than a new classical darśana: it presents the inherited śruti–Gītā–Śaṅkara framework through extended English commentary, public teaching, and the institutional study culture of Chinmaya Mission. The entry therefore records a major modern interpreter of Vedānta, while distinguishing his commentary tradition from the primary Sanskrit sources on which it comments. The repository now includes an owner-authorized, scan-grounded transcription of his Viṣṇu Sahasranāma commentary; the other listed commentaries remain at catalogue level until their own lawful witnesses are acquired.

engaged_works.title: The Holy Geeta
engaged_works.ascription_notes: Chinmaya Mission's official shop identifies the chapter commentary set as authored by Swami Chinmayananda and published by Chinmaya Prakashan.
engaged_works.summary: A modern English commentary on all eighteen chapters of the Bhagavad-Gītā. It is listed here as a major modern interpretive witness, not as a replacement for the Gītā's Sanskrit text or its classical commentaries. A local, rights-cleared edition and passage-level audit are required before the reader quotes or translates it.

engaged_works.title: Commentaries on principal Upanishads
engaged_works.ascription_notes: Chinmaya Mission catalogues list Chinmayananda commentaries on the major Upaniṣads, including Kaṭha, Kena, and Muṇḍaka.
engaged_works.summary: A series of modern English commentaries on major Upaniṣads. The series establishes Chinmayananda's relevance to the timeline as an extensive modern Advaita interpreter, while its individual editions and passages remain to be acquired and audited.

engaged_works.title: Thousand Ways to the Transcendental
engaged_works.ascription_notes: Chinmaya Mission publication listings identify this as Chinmayananda's commentary on the Viṣṇu Sahasranāma.
engaged_works.summary: A modern Advaita commentary on the thousand names of Viṣṇu. The complete name-by-name English is presented in an owner-authorized reader, keyed to the 107 Sanskrit name-stanzas and kept distinct from the site's separate grammatical notes.

reception_notes: Chinmaya Mission's catalogues and archives preserve the broad publication and teaching reception of these commentaries. The Viṣṇu Sahasranāma reader now has an authorized local witness; claims about Chinmayananda's other works remain source-limited.
